_about: mallesons.com — classified from MANUAL LIVE CAPTURES (rendered DOM + desktop/mobile screenshots of the agreed 295-URL sample, AU + SG; the live site is Cloudflare-protected). First reviewed on Internet Archive snapshots, re-validated on the live captures. Evidence: dump-variants + review-sheet.jpg + the user's desktop/mobile screenshots.

cmp-container.rationale: Page root grid (24-column aem-Grid) → EDS page body.

dynamicContainer.rationale: Dynamic container holding embeds / cookie banner / promo boxes / XFs → EDS section.

container.rationale: Layout container (pc_fixed_width / margin modifiers) → EDS section + section-metadata style.

customer-container.rationale: Page shell container (XFs + content container) → EDS page body.

ex-second-part2.rationale: Expertise-page content container (article displays, awards, testimonials, people contacts) → EDS section.

ex-second-box.rationale: Right-hand / lower content container of people and expertise pages (related news, 'Meet our team', contacts) → EDS section.

ex-first-box.rationale: Two-column people/expertise body: breadcrumb + lead + body copy on the left, a dark aside (key contact slider, 'Examples of recent work', Chambers/Legal500 testimonials) on the right; on mobile the aside drops below the body → Columns (content + aside).

sideBar.rationale: Article aside: highlighted callout ('Who has to report?') beside copy, plus related-insight links → Columns (aside variant).

header.rationale: Header XF: burger + mega-menu navigation (Expertise / Insights / Our People / Careers panels), search, region switcher (AU | EN) → EDS header (nav fragment).

footer.rationale: Footer XF (About / Expertise / Offices / Insights link columns, social icons, legal links) → EDS footer fragment.

breadcrumb.rationale: Breadcrumb nav with home icon → Block Collection Breadcrumbs.

carousel.rationale: Home hero carousel (role=group / tabpanel slides with CTA) → Carousel.

banner.rationale: Common page banner (image + masked title) → Hero.

practise-banner.rationale: Practice / solution banner (full-width image or colour, letter-spaced title between rules) → Hero (practice variant).

topic-banner.rationale: Insight topic banner (article type, title) → Hero (topic variant).

promoBox.rationale: Dark promo box ('Find out more' / '24/7 support & emergency advice hotline') with heading, copy and CTA → Hero (promo variant).

homePromobox.rationale: Home promo tiles (image, title, link) → Cards.

trendingInsights.rationale: 'Trending insights' topic tiles (image, title, copy, 'Discover now') → Cards (author-curated).

topicsHome.rationale: 'Explore our topics' tile grid → Cards (tile variant).

columnDisplay.rationale: Linked card grid (cards / cards4 modifiers) → Cards.

featureInsightWithImage.rationale: Featured insight (image, title, link) → Cards (featured variant).

awardsAndRanking.rationale: Awards & rankings list (award logos + descriptions) → Cards.

location.rationale: Office locations (Australia / Singapore offices, address, phone, map link) → Cards.

article-pub-download.rationale: Publication download card (cover image, title, size, Download link) → Cards (download variant).

testimonialQuote.rationale: Client testimonial quote (Chambers & Partners / Legal500 attribution) → Quote.

quote.rationale: Pull quote on a background → Quote.

accordion.rationale: Expandable panels (expand buttons, role=region) with image + text → Accordion.

textAndTitle.rationale: Title + text (large title / subtitle / background-image modifiers) → default content with section styles.

image.rationale: Image (e.g. 'How we can help' diagrams) → default-content picture.

multi-button.rationale: Button(s) with optional icon ('Open the tracker', 'Meet contact') → default-content buttons.

alumniNav.rationale: Alumni section link list → default content list.

subPractiseBanner_title.rationale: Sub-practice title with back link → default content.

starPartner.rationale: Star partner rich text → default content.

banner-image-authors.rationale: Author line inside article/topic banners → part of the hero / article-header content.

ex-head-title.rationale: Banner title text → part of the hero content.

test.rationale: Common banner title (component named 'test') → part of the hero content.

article-type.rationale: Article-type link in topic banners → part of the hero / page metadata.

loading.rationale: Loading spinner for client-rendered listings → not migrated (block handles its own loading state).

par_header.rationale: People profile header on lawyer pages: name, title, office, phone/mobile/email, vCard and portrait — structured profile data (typically fed from the firm's people directory). Custom people-profile block (auto-populated from profile metadata).

pc_fixed_width.rationale: Inner layout of the people profile header → part of the people-profile block.

keyContact.rationale: Key contact slider (photo, name, title, office, 'Meet contact', pager dots) in the aside of expertise / insight pages, selected by practice/tag → query-driven custom block over the people index.

peopleContact.rationale: Practice team contacts → part of the key-contacts block.

article-banner.rationale: Insight article header: type, title, date, authors, hero image and tag links from page metadata → custom article-header auto-block.

categories.rationale: Article category tags (from page tags) → part of the article-header / metadata block.

topics.rationale: Article topic tags (client-rendered) → part of the article-header / metadata block.

share.rationale: Social share bar (LinkedIn, email, print…) with a reading-progress indicator on insight articles → small custom block.

aiSummary.rationale: AI-generated article summary on insight pages (rendered client-side from a summary service) → custom block + API integration.

homeLatestThinking.rationale: 'Latest thinking' rail of the newest insights (type, title, date, summary, 'Explore latest thinking') → query-index listing block.

article-display.rationale: 'Latest news' / 'Latest publications' / 'Related articles' lists filtered by practice/topic → query-index listing block.

relatedNews.rationale: '<Person> in the news' list on people pages — articles mentioning the lawyer → query-index listing block (related variant).

exploreArticle.rationale: Insights finder: keyword search, type/topic/sector/practice filters, sort and paging (client-rendered results) → custom search block over the query index.

meetOurPeople.rationale: People directory search: keyword, A–Z index, role/office/practice filters, sort and paging → custom people-finder block over a people index.

meetOurTeam.rationale: 'Meet our team' on practice/solution pages: Regions / Sectors / Practices / Surname filters, keyword search, sort, region chip ('Australia'), 6-up people cards with 'Meet contact', pagination; single column on mobile → people-finder block (team variant).

meetOurTeamManual.rationale: Manually curated team list with paging → people-finder block (manual variant).

quickLookUp.rationale: Quick look-up panel (people / practices / sectors / offices selectors) → custom block.

cookieComponent.rationale: Bespoke cookie-consent manager on every page (category checkboxes, accept/reject/save) → custom consent block, or replace with a consent-management platform loaded via delayed.js.

exploreExpertiseSearch.rationale: 'Explore our expertise' search box that live-filters the Practices and Sectors directories on /expertise → custom expertise-explorer block (search + filtered directory).

exploreExpertisePractices.rationale: Practices directory: two-column list of practices with expandable sub-practice links and 'Expand all', filtered by the expertise search → part of the expertise-explorer block.

exploreExpertiseSectors.rationale: Sectors directory (same pattern as practices) → part of the expertise-explorer block.

homeFeatureInsights.rationale: 'Featured insights' list on home / topic hubs (title, summary, date, 'Read more', 'Explore more') → query-index listing block (featured variant).

singleStarPartner.rationale: Single key-contact card in a topic-page aside (name, bio, photo, contact button) → key-contacts block (single variant).

search-page.rationale: Site search results page: query box plus type facets (All / Insights / News / People / Expertise …) and paged results → Block Collection Search on the query index, with a facet-tab variant.

stats.rationale: Stat tiles over a background image ('190 partners', '1,100+ lawyers', '200 years') → Cards (stat variant).

timeline.rationale: Numbered principles list (1–6, heading + copy), e.g. '6 key principles that shape the way we use AI' → Cards (numbered variant) or a styled ordered list.

newNormal.rationale: Featured publication card on topic hubs (type/date, title, summary, 'Read more') → Cards (featured variant, author-curated).

testimonial.rationale: List of attributed testimonials ('What our CPD attendees said') → Quote (multi-quote variant).

subSectorBanner_title.rationale: Sub-sector banner title (back link + title on a dark band) → Hero (sub-sector variant).

button.rationale: Home-icon button (breadcrumb home link on careers pages) → default content / part of breadcrumbs.

padding.rationale: Spacer component (empty) → not migrated; section spacing styles.

test-center.rationale: Centred banner title text (component named 'test-center') → part of the hero content.
